# Third-Party Assets

Selected models, animations, textures, particles, and environment tiles used by the rhythm-action prototype.

## Find an asset

- [KayKit Adventurers](KayKit/Adventurers/README.md): selected character models
- [KayKit animations](KayKit/CharacterAnimations/README.md): selected humanoid clips
- [Kenney Tiny Dungeon](Kenney/TinyDungeon/README.md): arena tiles
- [Free asset credits](FreeAssets/ASSET_CREDITS.md): Kenney textures and particles
- [License records](Licenses/README.md), [inactive archive](_Archive/README.md), and [reference material](_Documentation/README.md)

## Add or change assets

Import only assets with confirmed commercial-use and redistribution permission; prefer CC0 where suitable. Keep only needed assets and update the source/license records. Avoid full packs and duplicate formats.

Imported visuals remain optional children beneath gameplay roots. Keep health, combat, rhythm, colliders, telemetry, and scoring on the project's gameplay prefabs. Follow the [development guide](../../DEVELOPMENT.md) for import and validation steps.
